name: Barbarian
description: Fights in a controlled fury that costs them something afterwards.

name: Bard
description: Works magic through performance, and gossip through everything else.

name: Cleric
description: Channels a god's power and fields all the questions that come with it.

name: Druid
description: Speaks for the wild, wears its shapes, and distrusts most cities.

name: Fighter
description: Trained rather than gifted, which they consider the more reliable option.

name: Monk
description: Turns discipline into force through a body treated as an instrument.

name: Paladin
description: Bound by an oath that is either their spine or their cage.

name: Ranger
description: Border-walker and tracker, more comfortable with a quarry than a crowd.

name: Rogue
description: Solves problems with timing, leverage, and a knife held very precisely.

name: Sorcerer
description: Magic in the blood, uninvited and not always well-behaved.

name: Warlock
description: Signed a contract with something vast; the payments are ongoing.

name: Wizard
description: Magic as research discipline, with the paperwork and rivalries to match.

name: Artificer
description: Puts magic inside objects and takes it apart to see how it complained.

name: Blood Hunter
description: Turned their own blood into a weapon against monsters, at obvious cost.

name: Alchemist
description: Bombs, mutagens, and elixirs, all field-tested somewhat recklessly on themselves.

name: Champion
description: A cause given armour — protective, punitive, or something less comfortable.

name: Gunslinger
description: Lives by a firearm they maintain better than any relationship.

name: Inventor
description: One brilliant device, constantly overclocked and occasionally on fire.

name: Investigator
description: Solves crimes by pursuing a lead with unreasonable confidence.

name: Kineticist
description: An open channel to an element, gating raw power through their own body.

name: Magus
description: Braids spellwork into swordplay and lands both in the same breath.

name: Oracle
description: Given divine power without being asked, plus a curse as a receipt.

name: Psychic
description: Casts from imagination alone, which is thrilling right up until it isn't.

name: Summoner
description: Shares a soul with an eidolon that has its own opinions.

name: Swashbuckler
description: Fights on panache, which means the flourishes are load-bearing.

name: Thaumaturge
description: No magic of their own — just esoterica, nerve, and the right talisman.

name: Witch
description: Their familiar carries the spells and does not fully explain where they came from.

name: Cavalier
description: Mounted, oath-bound, and loudly loyal to an order or a banner.

name: Inquisitor
description: A faith's blunt instrument, licensed to bend rules the clergy can't.

name: Occultist
description: Draws power from haunted objects and is careful about which ones they carry.

name: Skald
description: Sings a war-song that makes allies braver and battles louder.

name: Vigilante
description: Two identities, one wardrobe problem, and a growing list of loose ends.

name: Mesmerist
description: Plants suggestions in a mark's mind and waits for them to bloom.

name: Spiritualist
description: Bound to a phantom of unresolved emotion that follows them everywhere.

name: Blacksmith
description: Hammer, forge, and the only person in town who can fix a hinge properly.

name: Herbalist
description: Knows which leaf mends and which leaf ends, and charges the same for both.

name: Cartographer
description: Draws the world as it is and quietly resents everyone who moves a border.

name: Scribe
description: Copies documents for a living and reads far more of them than is polite.

name: Tavernkeep
description: Pours drinks, hears everything, and remembers which tabs are still open.

name: Caravan guard
description: Paid to be bored, and only earns it about twice a season.

name: Sailor
description: Reliable at sea, unmoored on land, and superstitious in very specific ways.

name: Fisher
description: Up before dawn, home smelling of it, and reading weather like a language.

name: Miner
description: Works where the air runs out, and knows which knocks in the rock mean run.

name: Farmhand
description: Strong, weather-worn, and unimpressed by anyone's talk of destiny.

name: Hunter-trapper
description: Lives off the treeline, trades pelts, and speaks in short sentences.

name: Falconer
description: Trains birds for hunting and messages, and prefers their company.

name: Undertaker
description: Handles the dead with a gentleness that unsettles the living.

name: Ratcatcher
description: Paid by the tail, and knows the city's underside better than its mayor.

name: Lamplighter
description: Walks the same route each dusk and notices when something is different.

name: Courier
description: Fast, discreet, and paid extra not to read the sealed ones.

name: Barber-surgeon
description: Cuts hair, sets bones, and pulls teeth, in whichever order the day demands.

name: Midwife
description: Has held half the town as newborns and is owed favours by all of them.

name: Plague doctor
description: Beaked mask, vinegar-soaked herbs, and a professional distance from hope.

name: Stonemason
description: Builds things meant to outlast them, and signs the work where nobody looks.

name: Glassblower
description: Shapes molten glass by breath, and carries the burns to prove the learning curve.

name: Brewer
description: Guards a recipe, a cellar temperature, and one very old grudge about hops.

name: Cook
description: Feeds a household or a company, and runs both more than anyone admits.

name: Court jester
description: The only person allowed to say it out loud, provided it's funny.

name: Tax collector
description: Arrives with a ledger and leaves with a shorter list of friends.

name: Town crier
description: Paid to announce the official version, and privately keeps the other one.

name: Archivist
description: Guards a collection nobody visits and knows exactly what's missing from it.

name: Astronomer
description: Charts the sky nightly, and has noticed a star behaving badly.

name: Locksmith
description: Makes locks by day; the reputation for the other thing is unearned, mostly.

name: Shipwright
description: Builds hulls that hold, and can name every boat they've lost.

name: Cooper
description: Barrels and casks — unglamorous, essential, and steady work in any war.

name: Weaver
description: Works a loom, and hides messages in patterns only their guild can read.

name: Dyer
description: Stained to the elbows in a colour that never quite washes out.

name: Beekeeper
description: Calm around stinging things, and tells the hive the household news.

name: Smuggler
description: Moves cargo past people who'd rather it stayed put, for a percentage.

name: Fence
description: Buys the stolen, sells the laundered, and never asks the second question.

name: Cutpurse
description: Fast hands, crowded markets, and a strict rule about never working alone.

name: Forger
description: Can reproduce a noble's seal, signature, and handwriting on demand.

name: Grave robber
description: Digs where nobody watches, and has met things that were not corpses.

name: Highwayman
description: Robs coaches with theatrical courtesy, which is why the ballads exist.

name: Con artist
description: Sells confidence, mostly; the goods are incidental.

name: Bounty hunter
description: Brings people back alive when the paperwork pays better for it.

name: Mercenary captain
description: Runs a company, negotiates the contracts, and writes the letters home.

name: Executioner
description: Masked, well-paid, and shunned by the same crowd that turns out to watch.

name: Monster hunter
description: Freelance, silver-equipped, and paid on delivery of something's head.

name: Relic appraiser
description: Tells you what your heirloom is worth and whether it's still cursed.

name: Curse-breaker
description: Unpicks other people's bad bargains, one clause at a time.

name: Spell component broker
description: Sources bat guano, phoenix ash, and worse, with a same-week guarantee.

name: Familiar breeder
description: Raises talking cats and imps, and vets the wizards more than the animals.

name: Ley-line surveyor
description: Maps magical currents for builders who'd rather not float away.

name: Portal warden
description: Staffs a gate to somewhere else and logs everything that comes through.

name: Golem mechanic
description: Maintains constructs, and has strong views on who counts as a person.

name: Airship navigator
description: Reads wind and star-charts above the clouds, where maps stop being useful.

name: Dream interpreter
description: Charges by the dream, and has started seeing the same one in several clients.

name: Beast tamer
description: Breaks nothing and convinces everything, given enough time and meat.

name: Dungeon delver
description: Professional grave-of-empires tourist, with a checklist and a rope budget.

name: Wandering priest
description: No parish, no tithes — just a circuit of villages that expect them each spring.

name: Bog diver
description: Salvages iron and bodies from peat water, and keeps what the bog gives up.

name: Sky-whaler
description: Hunts cloud-leviathans from a harpoon deck, on shares rather than wages.

name: Camp medic
description: Patches soldiers between skirmishes, and keeps a running mental tally of whose luck is about to run out.

name: Hospice keeper
description: Sits with the dying so they don't have to do it alone, and has heard every kind of last word there is.

name: Herald
description: Announces titles and reads decrees aloud, and privately corrects the pronunciation everyone else gets wrong.

name: Oath-witness
description: Presides over oaths sworn at court, and the binding magic remembers every clause better than the swearer does.

name: Stormsinger
description: Sings weather into shifting, a verse per gust, and blames any silence on an audience that didn't believe hard enough.

name: Totem-carver
description: Carves a spirit into wood well enough to wake it, and argues with the ones that turned out ornery.

name: Rootbinder
description: Grows a hedge into a wall overnight for the right price, and never quite kills the thing it replaces.

name: Forge-caller
description: Coaxes elemental fire into a forge that shouldn't burn that hot, and never explains how the coaxing works.

name: Seneschal
description: Runs the household so the lord can be seen to run it, and keeps a private ledger of who actually did what.

name: Miller
description: Grinds the grain for the whole valley, and knows exactly whose harvest came up short this year.

name: Tideturner
description: Talks a harbor's tide into arriving early for a price, and won't say what happens the day it doesn't listen.

name: Cat burglar
description: Works rooftops and skylights, and has strong professional opinions about anyone who still uses a crowbar.

name: Firebreak warden
description: Sets small fires on purpose to stop bigger ones, and is trusted by nobody until the summer proves them right.

name: Grovekeeper
description: Tends a stand of trees older than any nearby town, and treats every request to cut one down as a personal insult.

name: Beast-speaker
description: Doesn't tame anything — just translates, for a fee, and never repeats what the horses actually think of their riders.
